blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A purported bagman told the Sandiganbayan Third Division on Thursday that he delivered cash-filled suitcases, or “maleta,” to Sen. Vicente “Tito” Sotto III, former Rep. Stella Quimbo, and former Sen. Antonio Trillanes. Trillanes has denied the allegation, while the Inquirer is still awaiting comments from Sotto and Quimbo. READ: Witness: P10M allegedly offered for each recantation by ‘maleta boys’ Rodante Orbillo testified before the anti-graft court during the bail hearing of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez over alleged kickbacks totaling P7.44 billion from the government’s infrastructure projects, which were purportedly delivered by the so-called “Maleta boys.” Orbillo was […]...
